description: Anyone who builds dashboards needs intuitive, powerful and flexible tools. With graphomate chartrix, we combine our many years of experience as one of the leading visualisation providers in the field of business intelligence with state-of-the-art software technology and contemporary usability to support you in this task. The most important features at a glance Chart picker – enables you to quickly create a new chart layout with just a few clicks Overlay UI (user interface) – further adjustments and additions can be made intuitively directly on the chart Text editor – offers the option to customise, format and permanently save category labels and titles Collapsible hierarchies – provide a better overview when there are many data points Chart tooltips – enable high-performance drilldown to a freely selectable dimension XFL scripting – enables dynamic formatting and extension of functionality based on JavaScript Deviation waterfall – automatically displays, for example, sales development between two years by salesperson Line chart – can optionally display a deviation visualisation between two series Dynamic title elements – enable automatic adjustment of the title to changed data Licensing Free to use in Power BI Desktop for up to 7 data points.
